name: Taajir
description: A robust inventory management and point-of-sale system designed for small to medium-sized businesses, featuring real-time stock tracking, sales analytics and customized features to streamline operations.

name: Ludo
description: A browser take on the classic board game with AI opponents, pass-and-play, and real-time online lobbies, kept in sync through Socket.IO events and saved game snapshots.

name: News Updates
description: A news aggregator that pulls RSS feeds into country-aware categories, ranks stories by priority and reader endorsements, and comes with a full admin panel for feeds, intervals, and ad slots.

name: INCNXT
description: An online US company-formation service: data-driven pricing by state and package, a transactional checkout that creates the account on the way, a formation status flow, and an admin panel built from scratch.

name: Distrobooks
description: Subscription bookkeeping for consignment distributors: purchase orders, sales, returns, a ledger with full audit history, public stock menus, QR scanning, and Stripe-billed plans.

name: LearnYourWay
description: A private-tutoring marketplace with tutor applications, trial lessons, Stripe-paid packages, a live 100ms classroom, a notice-based reschedule and refund policy, and tutor payouts.

name: Ark Clam Academy
description: A workplace training app for German companies, with Whisper-generated English and German subtitles, translated quizzes, a fully localised Flutter client, and WebSocket team chat.

name: ClassConnect
description: A school learning management system where I built the component library the whole interface is made from, then wired it to a FastAPI backend with server-side auth and role-based routes.

name: ResNow
description: A restaurant reservation dashboard. I built the bookings timeline, which lays each table out against fifteen-minute slots on a CSS grid, plus the shared navigation and form components.

name: DreamUni
description: A marketplace where verified university students share their winning personal statements with applicants, with admin approval of offer letters and Stripe Connect split payouts.

name: Raz Tutoring
description: A bold marketing site for a small online tutoring business, built in a few weeks on my own Svelte component kit, with the start of a dashboard for tutors and students.

name: Islamic Events
description: A bilingual events platform for community and charity programmes: categorised event listings, per-event registration forms built from a JSON schema, optional fixed or open fees in BDT, Google sign-in, and an admin area for events and registrations.

name: Campus Bus Tracker
description: A campus transport system where a gate camera reads bus number plates with YOLOv8 and EasyOCR to mark buses in or out, drivers stream their location live over WebSockets, and commuters follow routes and reserve seats.

name: PSPlatform
description: A team workspace for organisations: invite-based teams, a realtime kanban board, end-to-end encrypted group messaging, posts written in a block editor, invoices, shared files, and a separate admin console.

name: IoT Manager
description: A device-management backend and dashboard for an organisation's sensors: per-device access tokens, temperature and file ingestion buffered through a Redis queue and written in batches, and a dashboard for devices, keys, files, and users.

name: Serum Diagnostics
description: A diagnostic-centre management system covering patient diagnoses, lab reporting, report delivery, dues, expenses, and doctor commissions, with TCP listeners that take results straight from lab analysers over HL7 and ASTM.

name: Preorder Manager
description: A small preorder admin built around Server Actions: a list with server-side filtering, sorting, and pagination, inline status toggles, and a shared create and edit form with validation and toast feedback.

name: RA Marketplace
description: A property marketplace for renting and selling, with separate provider and seeker accounts, listings that go through admin approval, map-based property locations, and paid subscriptions with payment history.

name: JP Auction Center
description: A chassis-number lookup service for Japanese auction cars: buyers search a chassis number to see its auction sheet, and staff manage cars, documents, QR codes, and approval status from a dashboard.

name: Svelte Design System
description: A Svelte and Tailwind implementation of a full design kit: around thirty-five dashboard, settings, landing, and informational pages built from one set of shared components and Chart.js charts.

name: Algorithm Debunker
description: A step-through visualiser for eight sorting algorithms, from bubble sort to heap sort. Enter your own numbers, then step forwards and backwards or let it auto-play while each comparison and swap is highlighted.

name: Pathfinding Visualizer
description: A grid sandbox for comparing pathfinding algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, A*, and Yen's K shortest paths) with 4- or 8-directional movement, editable blockades, and animated traversal.

name: Waive
description: A map-first discovery app that lists events, food, offers, and services near you next to an OpenLayers map, with switchable base layers, a liked state, and animated list transitions.

name: Quiz App
description: A timed quiz app where anyone can build a quiz with a time limit and take it later. The countdown runs in a Web Worker so it stays accurate when the tab is in the background.

name: Front-end Playground
description: A collection of early front-end work: landing pages and storefront templates, ad banners, a command-palette search UI, a Three.js and cannon-es physics sandbox, and an in-browser face-detection check.

name: Metro HMS
description: A desktop hospital and diagnostic-centre management system: patient registration across lab, indoor, and hospital care, lab test billing with discounts and dues, per-test report templates rendered to PDF, admissions, daily transactions, and test statistics.

name: TechHarbor UI
description: A SvelteKit component kit and dashboard starter, with inputs, uploads, tabs, steppers, a calendar, and nested layouts, plus a real-time chat module backed by a FastAPI service with JWT auth and WebSocket chatrooms.
